source_evidence: Exact player 'Keep going on o make room for the others' authorizes V moving out of culvert and making room, treated as end of R1 after action/BA already spent. Temporary explicit geometry ruling honors prior DM offer to emerge: P8 leans at opening rather than sealing full opening, V can crawl into adjacent unoccupied interior square(65,-35) without crossing P8's space. V crawls5ft actual costing10ft and stands15ft, total25ft/30ft movement; remains in P8 reach, no OA, no additional resource spent. V upright, 5ft unused ends turn. P2 Scout moves to(65,0) with clear bow line; P3 Scout moves(40,-30) with clear southern shooting lane; P4 Guard moves(60,-35); P5 Knight moves(65,-30) and orders 'Inside the walls! To arms!' after observing V emerge; P8 at mouth(70,-40); P6 perch(40,40,z15) has partial cover from melee bodies, V effective AC21 against P6, otherwise AC19. Genuine batch64346020f3a2fef41412593b662900fe: P2 longbow d20 8+4=12 miss,11+4=15 miss; P3 longbow18+4=22 hit d8 8+2=10 V48→38,13+4=17 miss; P4 spear nat20 critical 2d6(6,3)+1=10 V38→28; P5 greatsword14+5=19 hit 2d6(4,3)+3=10 V28→18, nat1 miss; P8 spear8+3=11 miss; P6 longbow nat20 critical 2d8(3,3)+2=8 V18→10,17+4=21 hit d8(5)+2=7 V10→3. Total45 damage, no V reaction or unchosen resource use. Cirren R1 crawls from 10ft inside through unobstructed side route, 15ft actual/30ft movement, ends prone(75,-30). Independently prioritizes V at3HP: BA third-level Healing Word, slots3rd3→2, genuine batch c8f3565471ad826e438b1f5ad6c6f46f 3d4(3,4,4)+Wis5=16 heal V3→19; action Toll the Dead vs wounded P8 WIS save nat1+0=1 vs16 fails, 2d12(2,8)=10 necrotic, P8 6→0 dead ordinary hostile NPC. No concentration. P1 Veteran R1 moves to(65,-5) and fires heavy crossbow at V with half cover from melee; genuine batch3ebfcd73b9504db90d0d485dc6c7e7dc 5+3=8 vs21 misses. Fenar R1 uses Athlete feat (stand costs5ft), crawls15ft costing30ft, stands5ft, advances5ft to(70,-35), uses40ft speed no MP. BA Rage chooses claws, Rage4→3/4, active house10min, Reckless attacks vs captain AC18. Same batch: double-claw rend greataxe adv4,15 keep15+8=23 hit d12(1)+7=8, P5 52→44; beast claw adv17,10 keep17+9=26 hit d6(2)+8=10 P5 44→34; extra claw adv11,9 keep11+9=20 hit d6(6)+8=14 P5 34→20. Fenar full59/59, attacks against Fenar advantage until next turn start, Rage resistance, Shift inactive. R2 P7 maintains west gate and Dodges, no movement/no attack, ordinary defense, current V initiative15 with fresh action/BA/movement/reaction. No remote signal sent, two unarmed laborers remain unharmed, no reinforcements, no morale break trigger yet. No automatic Sneak Attack or spend on V's upcoming turn; Fenar now adjacent to captain, so V can attack captain with SA if no disadvantage. All other custody, evidence, provisions, purse, diplomacy, estate unchanged; LR already0/6. Full RNG receipts in visible execution and event data.
